explanation: Three-module analytic LoRA: rank 3 at layer 14 MLP uses covariance-regularized wrong-versus-correct contrast readouts, constrained to zero mean on plain/correct-guess and earlier-prefix controls. It removes shared suggestion conditioning selectively for wrong guesses while retaining the conflict direction; the main-prefix correction is 1.8 times the measured contextual gap. Rank-8 output projections at attention layers 15 and 19 attenuate protected word-copying and digit-copying components, preserving corrective heads. Constructed with closed-form linear algebra, calibrated using exact local effects and logit-lens estimates on unedited activations across facts and phrasings. No gradients, optimizers, or edited-model forward passes. All adapter keys, dimensions, ranks, and finite values validated.
